sources.title: π0.5: VLA Model for Open-World Robots | PDF - Scribd
sources.snippet: The π0.5 model is a vision-language-action system designed for robots to perform complex tasks in new environments, leveraging diverse data sources for broad generalization. It combines training from multiple robots, high-level semantic predictions, and web data to enable mobile manipulators to execute long-horizon manipulation tasks, such as cleaning kitchens and bedrooms.
